text:
cam (AE): FYI - SolaceCare asked for a POC next week. Their procurement team needs a single monthly committed number, plus an AZ-eviction fallback and clear language about customer-managed keys / HSM. They also want to know split cost if they opt into quantized runtime.

rachel (SE): They will not accept burst-only. Finance wants line-item for reserved capacity, plus an option for the first 3 months at an intro discounted rate.

omar (Solutions): Quick sizing note: workload: chat + embeddings mixed, peak ~9k rps, avg payload ~620 tokens. For predictable runrate recommend reserved pool = 4 GPUs (vA100-class equiv) with autoscale headroom to 7 for sustained surges. If they commit to quantized q8-only path, 3 reserved could be plausible.

cam (AE): Can you sketch three priced options we can send procurement: (1) baseline reserved; (2) reserved + prepay discount for 3mo; (3) reserved smaller + market burst credits? Keep monthly totals.

omar (Solutions): Short bullets for procurement deck:
- Option A: 4 reserved (baseline) in eu-west-1 Dedicated + enterprise security pack. Monthly = $33,200 (predictable).
- Option B: 4 reserved + 3-month prepay 10% discount: effective monthly = $29,880 for first 3 months, then $33,200.
- Option C: 3 reserved + burst credits pool: monthly = $27,000 but note: higher p99 risk under sustained spike and potential queueing delays.

rachel (SE): call out quantized price bin: if they opt into q8 runtime for non-sensitive traffic we estimate throughput x1.6; draft an alternate Option A-q where 3 reserved at q8 gives similar capacity and monthly ~$22,000 but requires model-compatibility acceptance.

omar (Solutions): will include an appendix: quantized-vs-fp multipliers and assumptions (q8 x1.6, q4 x1.3). Also add token-cost-per-1k-responses at 512/620 tokens.

anya (Security): From their questionnaire: mandatory CMK (customer-managed key) support, HSM wrapping request, and 12-month log retention. They also asked about key escrow and rotation policies. Hosted offering supports SOC2; HSM/BYOK is an enterprise add-on and requires signed addendum.

cam (AE): customer prefers Dedicated in eu-west-1 to satisfy residency. Also asked for the fallback behavior if an AZ loses capacity mid-ramp. They want a runbook.

omar (Solutions): fallback runbook (short):
1) Cross-AZ standby pool: keep 1-2 replicas in standby in secondary AZ with pre-synced KV cache snapshots.
2) On AZ eviction alert: route new requests to secondary AZ, spin additional replicas up to max_replicas (7).
3) Graceful degradation: route to a low-cost model variant (smaller model, 0.5x tokens) if GPU capacity exhausted.
4) Post-incident: KV re-sync and rehydrate primary pool.

rachel (SE): ops want concrete autoscale values we can include in the doc.

omar (Solutions): autoscale proposal snippet:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 7
  target_gpu_utilization: 0.68
  cooldown_seconds: 120
prewarm:
  kv_warmup: true
  concurrency: 10
  ramp_seconds: 900
fallback:
  degrade_to_variant: true
```

omar (Solutions): smoke test plan: synthetic ramp 0 -> 9000 rps over 15m; capture p50/p95/p99, queue-length and token_cost.csv per model variant. Example command: ```bash
loadgen --target 9000 --ramp 900 --payload=chat_620.json --capture=p99 --report=token_cost.csv
```

anya (Security): For HSM/BYOK: we support partner HSM wrapping. We'll need legal addendum and procurement to sign off on key handling SLA. Also note FIPS certification requirements add procurement time. I'll draft the security appendix and attach screenshots of KMS integration and rotation logs.

cam (AE): procurement also asked for SLA delta if they choose Dedicated vs Hosted with compliance pack. Can we call that out?

omar (Solutions): short note: Dedicated + enterprise pack unlocks 12mo logs, private control plane, and SLA-backed latency targets. Hosted standard = 90d logs, standard SLA. Price delta for security pack will be listed as a separate line item.

rachel (SE): legal wants HSM addendum template and also to know liability boundaries if keys are customer-managed.

anya (Security): note: when customers manage their keys (BYOK), we never hold plaintext private keys; we only perform wrapped key imports and attest key usage logs. I'll add explicit wording for liability and rotation contracts.

cam (AE): timeline: can we ship the questionnaire answers by Fri EOD, a pricing packet with the three options and quantized appendix by Mon, and infra prep for POC start Tue?

omar (Solutions): yes, I'll open a ticket and populate with calculations, autoscale YAML, smoke test, and the fallback runbook.

ops_bot: created ticket SRV-11733 "SolaceCare POC: committed pricing + HSM addendum" assigned to omar, due 2026-04-03. :white_check_mark:

rachel (SE): I'll prepare a one-page procurement summary that highlights the tradeoffs and the p99 caveats.

cam (AE): thanks all. One last thing - include a short note about measuring cost-per-1k-responses during the POC so procurement can reconcile actual usage vs the committed run-rate.

omar (Solutions): will include a token-cost collector in the smoke test and a daily cost digest. End of thread.
